1use anyhow::{anyhow, Result};
2
3use crate::db::CardId;
4use crate::legal::DecisionKind;
5use crate::state::{CardInstance, CardInstanceId, Phase};
6
7use super::debug_fingerprints;
8use super::GameEnv;
9
10impl GameEnv {
11    pub(crate) fn should_validate_state(&self) -> bool {
12        if cfg!(debug_assertions) {
13            return true;
14        }
15        self.validate_state_enabled
16    }
17
18    pub(crate) fn maybe_validate_state(&self, context: &str) {
19        if !self.should_validate_state() {
20            return;
21        }
22        if let Err(err) = self.validate_state() {
23            panic!("validate_state failed at {context}: {err}");
24        }
25    }
26
27    /// Run expensive invariants checks over the full game state.
28    ///
29    /// Intended for debug builds or diagnostics; returns a detailed error.
30    pub fn validate_state(&self) -> Result<()> {
31        use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
32        let mut errors = Vec::new();
33
34        let mut counts: [HashMap<CardId, i32>; 2] = [HashMap::new(), HashMap::new()];
35        for (owner, owner_counts) in counts.iter_mut().enumerate() {
36            let deck_list = &self.config.deck_lists[owner];
37            for card in deck_list.iter().copied() {
38                *owner_counts.entry(card).or_insert(0) += 1;
39            }
40        }
41
42        fn consume(
43            counts: &mut [HashMap<CardId, i32>; 2],
44            errors: &mut Vec<String>,
45            owner: u8,
46            card: CardId,
47            zone: &str,
48        ) {
49            let owner_idx = owner as usize;
50            let entry = counts[owner_idx].entry(card).or_insert(0);
51            *entry -= 1;
52            if *entry < 0 {
53                errors.push(format!("Owner {owner} has extra card {card} in {zone}"));
54            }
55        }
56
57        let mut instance_ids: HashSet<CardInstanceId> = HashSet::new();
58        fn check_instance(
59            instance_ids: &mut HashSet<CardInstanceId>,
60            errors: &mut Vec<String>,
61            card: &CardInstance,
62            zone: &str,
63        ) {
64            if card.instance_id == 0 {
65                errors.push(format!("Card instance id 0 in {zone}"));
66                return;
67            }
68            if !instance_ids.insert(card.instance_id) {
69                errors.push(format!(
70                    "Duplicate instance id {} in {zone}",
71                    card.instance_id
72                ));
73            }
74        }
75
76        for zone_player in 0..2 {
77            let p = &self.state.players[zone_player];
78            for card in &p.deck {
79                consume(
80                    &mut counts,
81                    &mut errors,
82                    card.owner,
83                    card.id,
84                    &format!("p{zone_player} deck"),
85                );
86                check_instance(
87                    &mut instance_ids,
88                    &mut errors,
89                    card,
90                    &format!("p{zone_player} deck"),
91                );
92            }
93            for card in &p.hand {
94                consume(
95                    &mut counts,
96                    &mut errors,
97                    card.owner,
98                    card.id,
99                    &format!("p{zone_player} hand"),
100                );
101                check_instance(
102                    &mut instance_ids,
103                    &mut errors,
104                    card,
105                    &format!("p{zone_player} hand"),
106                );
107            }
108            for card in &p.waiting_room {
109                consume(
110                    &mut counts,
111                    &mut errors,
112                    card.owner,
113                    card.id,
114                    &format!("p{zone_player} waiting_room"),
115                );
116                check_instance(
117                    &mut instance_ids,
118                    &mut errors,
119                    card,
120                    &format!("p{zone_player} waiting_room"),
121                );
122            }
123            for card in &p.clock {
124                consume(
125                    &mut counts,
126                    &mut errors,
127                    card.owner,
128                    card.id,
129                    &format!("p{zone_player} clock"),
130                );
131                check_instance(
132                    &mut instance_ids,
133                    &mut errors,
134                    card,
135                    &format!("p{zone_player} clock"),
136                );
137            }
138            for card in &p.level {
139                consume(
140                    &mut counts,
141                    &mut errors,
142                    card.owner,
143                    card.id,
144                    &format!("p{zone_player} level"),
145                );
146                check_instance(
147                    &mut instance_ids,
148                    &mut errors,
149                    card,
150                    &format!("p{zone_player} level"),
151                );
152            }
153            for card in &p.stock {
154                consume(
155                    &mut counts,
156                    &mut errors,
157                    card.owner,
158                    card.id,
159                    &format!("p{zone_player} stock"),
160                );
161                check_instance(
162                    &mut instance_ids,
163                    &mut errors,
164                    card,
165                    &format!("p{zone_player} stock"),
166                );
167            }
168            for card in &p.memory {
169                consume(
170                    &mut counts,
171                    &mut errors,
172                    card.owner,
173                    card.id,
174                    &format!("p{zone_player} memory"),
175                );
176                check_instance(
177                    &mut instance_ids,
178                    &mut errors,
179                    card,
180                    &format!("p{zone_player} memory"),
181                );
182            }
183            for card in &p.climax {
184                consume(
185                    &mut counts,
186                    &mut errors,
187                    card.owner,
188                    card.id,
189                    &format!("p{zone_player} climax"),
190                );
191                check_instance(
192                    &mut instance_ids,
193                    &mut errors,
194                    card,
195                    &format!("p{zone_player} climax"),
196                );
197            }
198            for card in &p.resolution {
199                consume(
200                    &mut counts,
201                    &mut errors,
202                    card.owner,
203                    card.id,
204                    &format!("p{zone_player} resolution"),
205                );
206                check_instance(
207                    &mut instance_ids,
208                    &mut errors,
209                    card,
210                    &format!("p{zone_player} resolution"),
211                );
212            }
213            for (slot_idx, slot) in p.stage.iter().enumerate() {
214                if let Some(card) = slot.card {
215                    consume(
216                        &mut counts,
217                        &mut errors,
218                        card.owner,
219                        card.id,
220                        &format!("p{zone_player} stage[{slot_idx}]"),
221                    );
222                    check_instance(
223                        &mut instance_ids,
224                        &mut errors,
225                        &card,
226                        &format!("p{zone_player} stage[{slot_idx}]"),
227                    );
228                }
229            }
230        }
231
232        for (owner, owner_counts) in counts.iter().enumerate() {
233            for (card, remaining) in owner_counts.iter() {
234                if *remaining != 0 {
235                    errors.push(format!(
236                        "Owner {owner} card {card} count mismatch ({remaining})"
237                    ));
238                }
239            }
240        }
241
242        if let Some(decision) = &self.decision {
243            if let Some(slot) = decision.focus_slot {
244                if slot as usize >= self.state.players[decision.player as usize].stage.len() {
245                    errors.push("Decision focus slot out of range".to_string());
246                }
247            }
248            match decision.kind {
249                DecisionKind::AttackDeclaration => {
250                    if self.state.turn.attack.is_some() {
251                        errors.push("Attack declaration while attack context active".to_string());
252                    }
253                }
254                DecisionKind::LevelUp => {
255                    if self.state.turn.pending_level_up.is_none() {
256                        errors.push("Level up decision without pending level".to_string());
257                    }
258                }
259                DecisionKind::Encore => {
260                    let has = self
261                        .state
262                        .turn
263                        .encore_queue
264                        .iter()
265                        .any(|r| r.player == decision.player);
266                    if !has {
267                        errors.push("Encore decision without reversed options".to_string());
268                    }
269                }
270                DecisionKind::TriggerOrder => {
271                    if self.state.turn.trigger_order.is_none() {
272                        errors.push("Trigger order decision without pending order".to_string());
273                    }
274                }
275                DecisionKind::Choice => {
276                    if let Some(choice) = &self.state.turn.choice {
277                        if choice.player != decision.player {
278                            errors.push("Choice decision player mismatch".to_string());
279                        }
280                    } else {
281                        errors.push("Choice decision without pending choice".to_string());
282                    }
283                }
284                _ => {}
285            }
286        }
287
288        if self.state.turn.attack.is_some() && self.state.turn.phase != Phase::Attack {
289            errors.push("Attack context outside Attack phase".to_string());
290        }
291
292        if errors.is_empty() {
293            return Ok(());
294        }
295
296        let state_hash = debug_fingerprints::state_fingerprint(&self.state);
297        let phase = self.state.turn.phase;
298        let attack_step = self.state.turn.attack.as_ref().map(|c| c.step);
299        let tail_len = 8usize;
300        let actions_tail: Vec<String> = self
301            .replay_actions
302            .iter()
303            .rev()
304            .take(tail_len)
305            .rev()
306            .map(|a| format!("{a:?}"))
307            .collect();
308        let decisions_tail: Vec<String> = self
309            .replay_steps
310            .iter()
311            .rev()
312            .take(tail_len)
313            .rev()
314            .map(|s| format!("{:?}/{:?}", s.decision_kind, s.actor))
315            .collect();
316        let fallback_action = self
317            .last_action_desc
318            .as_ref()
319            .map(|a| format!("{a:?}"))
320            .unwrap_or_else(|| "None".to_string());
321        let payload = format!(
322            "seed={}\nphase={:?}\nattack_step={:?}\nlast_action={}\nactions_tail={:?}\ndecisions_tail={:?}\nstate_hash={}",
323            self.episode_seed,
324            phase,
325            attack_step,
326            fallback_action,
327            actions_tail,
328            decisions_tail,
329            state_hash,
330        );
331        Err(anyhow!("{}\n{}", payload, errors.join("; ")))
332    }
333}
